title: Apollo 8 — First to the Moon
description: 21 December 1968. Frank Borman, James Lovell, William Anders. First crewed lunar orbit. Saturn V AS-503, LC-39A.
author: Markus Leutwyler
fiction_note: Faithful recreation of the Apollo 8 launch timeline. Crew: Borman (CDR), Lovell (CMP), Anders (LMP). CapCom: Michael Collins.
debrief: Were all five F-1 engines at full thrust on liftoff?
Did the vehicle clear the tower cleanly at T+8s?
Max Q — was the throttle-back visible in the thrust profile?
S-IC staging: clean separation and S-II ignition confirmed?
Apollo 8 reached lunar orbit on Christmas Eve, 1968.
Anders: "We came all this way to explore the Moon, and the most important thing is that we discovered the Earth."
atmosphere:
December 21, 1968. The world watches from Cape Kennedy.
Frank Borman, James Lovell, William Anders.
The first human beings to leave Earth's gravity.
Bound for the Moon.
